label: Zoom
description: Capture one region of the computer's screen, enlarged to the screen's size with its proportions kept, so small text can be read. `args` is `{ region }`, the region as `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` in screen pixels, top left to bottom right.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: The region, in the shape the node's description gives. RouteComputerCall's `zoom` port hands it over from a model's tool call; written by hand, it is a record literal.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: A sentence a model can read back as the tool's result.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The enlarged region, a PNG kept past the run.

metadataPorts.name: tools
metadataPorts.description: The tools a model calls this node through, in Anthropic's names and in OpenAI's: gather them up to the LLM node's `tools` through metadata ports.

anthropic.description: See one region of the screen enlarged, to read small text or make out a small control. Coordinates stay those of the full screenshot afterwards.
anthropic.name: zoom

region.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1], the region's top left and bottom right corners, pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.
